title: Derived open test object ordinary Hom property
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an arbitrary open, with all derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] supplied in a common Hom universe. Let R be derived over restriction followed by Modules.overEquiv U [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]. For every A in D(O_U), there exists B in D(O_X) and an isomorphism A ≅ R(B) such that R.map: Hom(B,E) → Hom(R(B),R(E)) is bijective for every E in D(O_X).

source.place: Tag 08BT; sheaves.tex Tag 00A7 (2)-(4); exact-functor localization of the adjunction

proof.text: Construct L as the inverse of Modules.overEquiv U followed by exact extension by zero, and R as over restriction followed by that equivalence. Compose their underived adjunctions. The extension/restriction isomorphism makes extension by zero fully faithful, so its adjunction unit is invertible. Composition with the equivalence preserves this property.

Apply the termwise homotopy adjunction and Mathlib Adjunction.localization to obtain L.mapDerivedCategory ⊣ R.mapDerivedCategory. Derive the underived unit isomorphism using mapDerivedCategoryCompIso, mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and mapDerivedCategoryIdIso. The derived left adjoint is fully faithful, so its unit is invertible. Take B=L.mapDerivedCategory(A). The unit gives the required isomorphism. The adjunction formula is unit_A followed by R.map f, so cancellation of the unit and the Hom equivalence prove both injectivity and surjectivity.

proof_origin.based_on: Second reading: explicit reduction following Stacks 00A7 and 08BT

theorem exists_derivedOpen_testObject
    (X : Scheme.{uX}) (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))] :
    let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    ∀ A : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme,
      ∃ B : schemeDerivedCategory X, Nonempty (A ≅ R.obj B) ∧
        (∀ E : schemeDerivedCategory X,
          Function.Bijective (fun f : B ⟶ E ↦ R.map f))
